To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the outcome of adult ALL remains poor; (ii) the outcome of T cell lineage ALL is better than non-T cell lineage, especially B cell lineage ALL; and (iii) allogeneic stem cell transplantation in first remission in patients less than 50-years old is the best post-remission treatment option for ALL patients, especially for T cell lineage ALL.
